title: Demo Tomato Rice (SAMPLE — not a real recipe)
description: Seed fixture for schema and domain tests. Replace with chef-validated content. Never publish.

equipment.name: Heavy-bottomed cooking pot with tight lid
equipment.notes: Prevents scorching at base and traps steam

equipment.name: Wooden spoon or heatproof spatula
equipment.notes: For folding rice and stirring tomato base

ingredients.constraint: Must be drained thoroughly before steaming
Fry until raw tin flavour is eliminated

steps.instruction: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear, then drain.
Simmer the tomato base on medium heat until the oil rises.
steps.sensoryCue: Oil gathers at the edges and the sharp raw smell fades.

steps.instruction: Fold in the rice, cover tightly, and steam on low heat until tender.
steps.completionNote: Grains separate and stand, not mushy.

notes: Do not open the lid frequently during the final steaming step to avoid losing trapped moisture.
If rice is slightly firm after 20 minutes, sprinkle 2 tbsp of water and rest off heat for 5 minutes.
